fact: The law defines an Autorité de Protection and gives it functions (declarations and authorisations, transfer approval, investigation, guidelines) but has processing declarations go to the competent authority 'designated by regulation' (Art. 5); it names no constituted body or appointed members (document published 2016-07).

Presidential decree D/2017/184/PRG/SGG, signed at Conakry on 26 July 2017 and effective from signature, ratifies the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection signed at Malabo on 27 June 2014, following authorising law L/2017/023/AN of 16 June 2017.
